name: io.metamask.androidsdk.MainActivity
description: The MetaMask Android SDK includes this standalone main screen. In release 0.1.2 the app icon opens it, but it displays an empty screen and contains no wallet connection flow; release 0.6.6 keeps it available for direct opening without the app-icon link.
disableEffect: Blocking it hides the empty screen and may remove the app-icon entry point in versions that use it as the launcher.
